findings.problem: For "ready" the first answer most people would give is "bereit", which is also an everyday word and also means all set to go, so this hint does not rule it out.
findings.fix: hint: ready to go because you've finished getting ready (the word that also means finished, not bereit)

back.target: finished, done; ready (having finished getting ready)
back.example: Are you ready? We have to go.

note: The new hint has to keep this card apart from the word's other card, "finished, done", while still pointing to fertig and not bereit.
